sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Analyzes how well current or proposed applications meet business requirements. Identifies gaps and areas for improvement. Supports decision-making for customization or replacement. Aligns IT solutions with business processes. Enhances functional coverage and user satisfaction.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Ensures applications meet business requirements. Identifies gaps and improvement areas. Supports customization and optimization. Enhances user satisfaction and adoption. Aligns IT solutions with business goals.
